items.title: 德国法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno侵犯版权，驳回合理使用抗辩 / German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense

sources.title: 德国法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno侵犯版权，驳回合理使用抗辩 / German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense
sources.title_zh: 德国法院裁定AI音乐生成器Suno侵犯版权，驳回合理使用抗辩
sources.title_en: German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense
sources.title_original: German court rules AI music generator Suno violated copyrights， rejects fair use defense
sources.summary: 慕尼黑法院裁定，AI音乐生成器Suno在训练过程及输出结果中均侵犯版权，并驳回其合理使用抗辩。法院认定Suno 3.5和4版本模型可复现六首知名歌曲的原创元素，构成"记忆化"侵权，且责任归于Suno而非用户。该判决还认定美国版权法下的合理使用不适用于此案，目前尚未最终生效。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 慕尼黑法院在GEMA诉Suno案中认定，Suno模型可重现存储六首歌曲，训练与输出均侵权，并驳回德国文本数据挖掘例外与美国合理使用抗辩，判决Suno对输出负责。

sources.title_zh: OpenAI Astra 以约2000美元证明10项数学难题
sources.title_en: ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. solved using an internal …
sources.title_original: ten significant advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science. solved using an internal …
sources.summary: OpenAI 用下一代模型 Astra 内部版解决了数学与理论计算机科学领域的10项重大进展，总成本约2000美元（按 Sol API 价格计算）。Astra 证明了非 sofic 群的存在，并推翻 Connes 刚性猜想，成果涵盖 von Neumann 代数、高维球堆积、电路复杂度等。OpenAI 已发布全部10项证明，附 Lean 证书与 CoT 逐步推导。

sources.summary: > Keys with real blast radius > Here is what they unlock. > This is a floor, not an estimate of actual balances or unauthorized usage. The keys were verified but never used. > We cloned the public dataset hub end to end: every repository, every branch, every large-file object > The size is only half the story. These are the training sets behind models people actually use. The worst-hit ones are named, card-documented pretraining corpora that open models were built on. We verified every credentia
